criteria.semantics: A native whose alt is the image's alt text: what the picture says, in words.

keyboard.outcome: Passes it by: it is not a stop in the tab order.

criteria.name: The image's alt text.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my text size to 200% I SEE the page's text around the image grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I zoom the page to 400% I SEE the image scale down to the window's width, with no horizontal scrolling.

check.statement: The face emits a native element.
The image has its alt text, not empty, as the model gives it.
An image is not a control: nothing in it is a stop in the tab order.
WHEN I reach the image with a desktop screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) I HEAR its alt text and the role of image, not its file name.
WHEN I swipe to the image with a mobile screen reader (TalkBack, VoiceOver) I HEAR its alt text.

criteria.semantics: The window draws no picture: an image falls back to text, its alt text in fg on bg. GPUI exposes no accessibility tree, so the text does not reach assistive technology.

keyboard.outcome: Passes it by: it is not a stop in the tab order.

criteria.name: The image's alt text, as text.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my system text size to 200% I SEE the alt text grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I magnify the window with the system zoom I SEE the alt text whole.

check.statement: I SEE the image's alt text in its place, so what it says is there in words.
WHEN I reach the image's place with a screen reader (VoiceOver, Orca, Narrator) I HEAR its alt text.

criteria.note: GPUI 0.2.2 exposes no accessibility tree (no AccessKit): every HEAR check fails on this face today. Its SEE checks with a probe run on GPUI's test platform (gpui/src/native.rs), which no CI job runs yet (gpui/README.md, Verification); the rest are reported as not verified.
